reviews.text: I definitely do not recommend this place! The price is absurd – 550 baht for something you can buy elsewhere for half the cost. This is pure scamming and lack of honesty. Additionally, I advise you to double-check what the seller says because it’s hard to understand him, and he changes the prices during the conversation.
